comment: ADR-003 §6: every lockfile entry with an install script. CI runs `npm rebuild` only for entries with rebuild: true.

fsevents.reason: macOS file watching for dev tools; ships its prebuilt binary, the script only rebuilds it.

unrs-resolver.reason: Resolver for eslint-config-next; its postinstall only fetches a binary when the prebuilt optional package is missing.

esbuild.reason: Bundler under drizzle-kit (and vitest); its binary comes as a prebuilt @esbuild/<platform> optional package, and the postinstall only checks it.
